headline: RJH House / Wiyoga Nurdiansyah
context: The house is designed for a family of five that was looking for a tranquil space, contrary to the fast-evolving city of Jakarta Selatan. The main brief was to create a house that could accommodate big family gatherings and have lots of gardens.
